download_interleavedeval_data: download the InterleavedEval benchmark dataset from HuggingFace to a local data directory
force_redownload_interleavedeval: force re-download the InterleavedEval data from HuggingFace even if it already exists locally
load_interleavedeval_prompts: load InterleavedEval prompts and images from the downloaded data directory into a dictionary
extract_interleavedeval_zip_images: extract zip files from the InterleavedEval zipped_images directory during the download process
review_load_prompts_function: review the load_prompts function that parses interleaved_bench.json and builds prompt content with image paths
